architectureDecisions: D1 — Files: packages/agentic-system/src/supervised-backend.js exporting mapBackendOrderToAgentTask and runSupervisedBackendWork; packages/agentic-system/src/index.js re-exports those two after createLocalGitWorkspace / createLocalCommandVerifier; tests in packages/agentic-system/test/bb100-supervised-backend.test.js. Living: docs/living/system/agentic-application/state.md and capabilities.md. No package.json script; test:agentic already globs test/*.test.js. Fake CLI is the delivered packages/agent-tools/test/fixtures/fake-agent.mjs (read-only).

D2 — mapBackendOrderToAgentTask(order, context, { repositoryRoot, verifications, prompt }) uses parseBackendWorkOrder and BackendContextSchema.parse, then asserts context.repository.ref/revision match the order and context.files[].path equals order.requiredFiles. repositoryRoot is a required caller filesystem path; context.repository.ref is a logical id. prompt defaults to order.task. verifications is a non-empty array of { name, command, args, timeoutMs, claim } whose claims are unique and include BackendEvidenceClaim.TYPECHECK (backend.typecheck) and TESTS (backend.tests). Returns AGENT_TASK_V1 { id: order.id, repositoryRoot, baseRevision: order.revision, prompt, verifications: [{ name, command, args, timeoutMs }] }. No requiredFiles field (BB-102); context bytes stay out of the prompt. Invalid mapping throws TypeError; validateAgentTask still requires 40-hex baseRevision.

D3 — runSupervisedBackendWork({ tool, order, context, repositoryRoot, verifications, prompt, model, maxAttempts, timeoutMs, maxFeedbackChars, permissionProfile, env, eventSinks, tracer, invocationObserver }) maps via D2, then import()s runSupervisedTask/AgentTaskStatus from ../../agent-tools/src/supervisor.js and PermissionProfile from tool-adapters.js (permissionProfile default WORKSPACE_EDIT; invocationObserver/eventSinks/tracer/model default null/[]/null/null). BackendWorkResultSchema.parse fields are status, summary, revision, artifacts, evidence, gaps, blockers. AgentTaskStatus.ACCEPTED + 40-hex acceptedSha is re-grounded (D3b). TOOL_UNAVAILABLE -> BackendWorkStatus.BLOCKED, blockers ["TOOL_UNAVAILABLE"], revision null, empty artifacts/evidence. EXHAUSTED (NEVER_FIX, AUTH_FAIL, CLAIM_SUCCESS_NO_EDIT / AttemptOutcome.NO_CHANGE) -> FAILED, revision null, empty evidence. AUTH_FAIL is EXHAUSTED. ACCEPTED with null acceptedSha or last attempt NO_CHANGE cannot be APPLIED.

D3b — After ACCEPTED, createLocalGitWorkspace({ repositoryRoot, baseRevision: acceptedSha, worktreeRoot: mkdtemp }). Re-run each D2 verification with createLocalCommandVerifier({ name, claim, root: workspace.root, command, args, timeoutMs, requireUnchangedTree: true }).verify({ candidate: { id: order.repositoryRef, version: acceptedSha } }). If backend.typecheck or backend.tests is not VerificationStatus.PASS, or git diff --name-only order.revision acceptedSha is empty, dispose and return FAILED. Else evidence producer identity supervised-backend-adapter: createEvidenceArtifact kind BACKEND_MUTATION, metadata.claim BackendEvidenceClaim.MUTATION PASS, content { beforeRevision: order.revision, afterRevision: acceptedSha, lineageAdvanced: true }, subjectFromValue({ repositoryRef, revision: acceptedSha }, { type: "backend-candidate", producer: { identity: "supervised-backend-adapter", roles: ["executor"] }, metadata: { objectiveId, workOrderId: order.id } }), environmentRefFromValue({ repositoryRef, baseRevision: order.revision, resultRevision: acceptedSha }, { name: "supervised-backend-workspace" }); typecheck/tests via evidenceFromVerificationArtifact. artifacts = { ref: `git:${acceptedSha}:${path}`, path }. Dispose in finally. APPLIED must assessBackendCompletion ACCEPT; FAILED/BLOCKED evidence is [].

D4 — Do not inject createSupervisedAgentStrategy into createBackendWorker. Probe: BackendWorker evaluate is mutation-only (candidate.version !== order.revision) and workspace.act is APPLY_BACKEND_CHANGE, not RUN_AGENT_TOOL.

D5 — Tests drive packages/agent-tools/test/fixtures/fake-agent.mjs via defineAgentTool(AGENT_TOOLS.codex|{kiro,agy}, { command: process.execPath, prefixArgs: [fake] }) and FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO. FIX_FIRST -> APPLIED after verifier PASS at acceptedSha; FIX_AFTER_FEEDBACK -> APPLIED only after the retry; NEVER_FIX -> FAILED; CLAIM_SUCCESS_NO_EDIT -> FAILED with AttemptOutcome.NO_CHANGE; AUTH_FAIL -> FAILED (EXHAUSTED); missing command -> BLOCKED with blockers TOOL_UNAVAILABLE. Each run snapshots source HEAD, symbolic-ref, refs/heads and porcelain status and asserts equality afterwards.

D6 — SB1 reads packages/agentic-system/src/backend-worker.js as text and asserts it contains none of agent-tools, runSupervisedTask, createSupervisedAgentStrategy. SB1 also imports both packages/agentic-system/src/index.js and packages/agent-tools/src/index.js then calls mapBackendOrderToAgentTask (proves the public export and that mapping has no load-time agent-tools cycle).

D7 — Evidence basis: executed productization probe; executed composition probe over current main (status enums, schema keys, fake-CLI outcomes, acceptedSha checkoutable, invocationObserver present); delivered BB-096 workspace/verifier/completion; delivered BB-097 supervisor; delivered BB-098 default-null invocationObserver. BB-054 and BB-065 are not used.

D8 — Research gap closed: BackendWorkStatus is APPLIED/FAILED/BLOCKED; BackendWorkResultSchema.parse constructs APPLIED without createBackendWorker; D3 binds those identifiers. Remaining fail-closed: TOOL_UNAVAILABLE/EXHAUSTED/NO_CHANGE/failed re-ground never return APPLIED.

D9 — BB-098 re-ground: do not edit supervisor.js. Pass through invocationObserver (default null), eventSinks and tracer. Observation never decides BackendWorkStatus. Existing BB-097/BB-098 tests stay green because agent-tools is untouched.

D10 — ESM cycle: supervisor.js statically imports ../../agentic-system/src/index.js. supervised-backend.js therefore must not statically import agent-tools/src/index.js or supervisor.js. Dynamic import() inside runSupervisedBackendWork of the two leaf modules is the required seam. index.js may re-export the adapter after the local workspace/verifier named exports.
